audit.why: HARD at 7/10 fits the 47.61% over 439 games carried in the page's own win-rate table. Gangplank pokes from 625 with Parrrley on 4.5 seconds while your longest pre-6 reach is a 650 charge you cannot spend on poke, and his barrels deny you the wave. The lane is survived, not won.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; see notes for a win-rate discrepancy between the page table and the audit packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is written as unconditional — 'Glacial Prison turns every jungle visit into a guaranteed kill... he cannot Bilgewater Cutlass-cleanse the prison stun'.
audit.why: Riot on Remove Scurvy: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health', cooldown 22/20/18/16/14. It cures crowd control, not slows only — so it answers a Permafrost stun and a Glacial Prison stun alike. The level-6 spike is real but conditional on his W being spent, which is the number the page needed and never gave.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike re-priced against Remove Scurvy's 22-second cooldown: bait the citrus, land the second CC.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) 'Bilgewater Cutlass W' — his W is Remove Scurvy; Bilgewater Cutlass is an item. (b) 'his W Bilgewater Cutlass only cleanses slows, not a Permafrost stun already landing' and 'his W cannot cleanse a prison stun' — flatly contradicted by Riot's text. (c) Parrrley, his primary poke and the ability that actually decides the lane, is never named anywhere on the page. (d) 'Permafrost passive armor' fuses the E stun with Fury of the North's Frost Armor.
audit.why: Riot: Remove Scurvy 'cures crowd control effects and restores Health' (22/20/18/16/14s). Parrrley: 625 range, 4.5s flat. Fury of the North: 'Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows' — nothing to do with Permafrost, which is a 1.5s stun at max Frost stacks.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named and correctly described as a full CC cure plus heal; Parrrley named with its 4.5s / 625 numbers; Frost Armor named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names 'Powder Kegs (Barrels)' as the matchup-defining cooldown and tells you to 'count it out loud'.
audit.why: Riot's data gives Powder Keg a cooldown of 0 — it runs on stored charges, and the kit file carries no charge timer, so there is no number to count. The countable, matchup-deciding cooldown is Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14s, because it is what erases your only win condition.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt around Remove Scurvy, with Parrrley's 4.5s as the poke clock and Arctic Assault's 18s as your exit.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — no source named, no item named.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy restores health on a 22-second cooldown, which is what lets him reset an even trade. Thornmail is already in the recommended build and carries Grievous Wounds, so the anti-heal costs nothing if the order is stated.
audit.corrected: Thornmail named as the Grievous Wounds source and tied to the Remove Scurvy heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you what happens when Cannon Barrage lands on a fight you have committed to.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s and genuinely global (30000 range), slowing and damaging a zone. For an immobile tank whose only repositioning tool is an 18-second charge, a global slow zone dropped on top of a won skirmish is how a 2v2 win becomes a death. That is a real interaction and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Left to the late-game block, which already frames his R as always-live somewhere on the map. Not padded further, since the length band had no room.

edits.after: Neither of you threatens at level 1 — he has one keg out and your Frost Armor from Fury of the North is only armour and MR; farm, and watch where the first Powder Keg lands.
edits.before: Neither of you has a meaningful level 1 threat — his barrel is barely stacked and your Permafrost passive armor is thin; farm and watch where he plants the first keg.

edits.after: Levels 1 through 3 are a careful dance around his barrels. Take W first, and walk around placed Powder Kegs rather than attacking them — every keg you detonate for free is a trade he wins. His real chip is Parrrley: 4.5 seconds flat at 625 range, and committing your 650 charge into a live keg chain gets you chunked before the knock-up lands. At level 3 your window opens — when he steps up to plant a keg with no other keg live, Q into his body, both Winter's Wrath arcs to max Frost, then Permafrost. Expect Remove Scurvy: it cures crowd control and heals, 22 seconds at rank 1, so the stun that matters is the one after it.
edits.before: Level 1 through 3 is a careful dance around his barrels. Take W first, walk around placed Powder Kegs rather than attacking them — every keg you detonate for free is a trade he wins. At level 2 your Q gives you a threat range but committing it into a live barrel chain will get you chunked before the knock-up lands. At level 3 your window opens: when he steps up to plant a keg without another keg already live, Q dash into his body, double W-strike to stack Frost, and E Permafrost the stun before he can light it — his W Bilgewater Cutlass only cleanses slows, not a Permafrost stun already landing.

edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 belong to him — two-keg chains explode for a huge chunk even through Frost Armor, and you have no kill threat without level 6. Take Doran's Shield and Second Wind to absorb, shove into tower to deny his barrel gold, and never walk through unwarded brush where kegs are pre-planted. Level 6 changes the arithmetic: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range stun he cannot plant a keg fast enough to answer. What he can answer with is Remove Scurvy, which cures the stun outright — so bring a jungler, force the citrus, then land the second CC.
edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 belong to him — two-keg chains explode for half your HP even through Permafrost passive, and you have no kill threat without level 6. Use Doran's Shield and Second Wind to absorb, shove into tower to deny his passive gold from barrel last-hits, and do not walk through unwarded brush where kegs are pre-planted. Level 6 changes everything: Glacial Prison is a ranged stun that arrives faster than he can react to plant a defensive keg, and his W cannot cleanse a prison stun — call your jungler and threaten the first tower.

edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s): matchup-defining — it cures your stun and heals him, so the second CC is the one that lands. - Parrrley is 4.5s poke at 625. - Your Q is 18s: the moment it all goes wrong. - R: the moment it all goes right.
edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs (Barrels): matchup-defining — Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.after: Track Remove Scurvy, 22s at rank 1: it cures your Permafrost or Glacial Prison stun and heals him. Bait it, then land the CC that counts.
edits.before: Track Gangplank’s Powder Kegs (Barrels): Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.

edits.before: Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pots. First: Sunfire Aegis into Plated Steelcaps or Mercs; then Thornmail — its Grievous Wounds cuts the Remove Scurvy heal that resets his trades.
edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pots. First: Sunfire Aegis into Plated Steelcaps or Mercs; then Thornmail or Kaenic Rookern by damage type. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.

notes: WIN-RATE DISCREPANCY, unresolved: the page's own win-rate table gives Sejuani 47.61% over 439 games into Gangplank, while the audit packet at scratchpad/packets/sejuani.json gives 52.79% over 197 games and raises a defect ('level chart contradicts data: Sejuani wins 52.79% but the chart gives Gangplank 3/7 stages vs 0'). The two disagree on which side of 50% this lane sits, so the level chart was left exactly as it is and no rating was touched. See questionsForUser. Separately, the biggest single error on this page is the claim that Gangplank's W cannot cleanse your stun — Riot's text says Remove Scurvy cures crowd control effects outright, so the page's level-6 win condition was built on a mechanic that works the opposite way. The phrase 'Bilgewater Cutlass W' should be grepped for across champ-data; it is an item name being used as an ability name.
